title: Inside Rajeev Khandelwal’s Sustainable Goa Lifestyle
desc: Rajeev Khandelwal shared that his lifelong fitness comes from simple, nutritious eating habits ingrained since childhood, not from strict discipline or acting demands. Growing up in an Army household, he regularly ate foods like sprouts and amla, which shaped his taste preferences so strongly that junk food never appealed to him. He still prefers basic, home-cooked meals like moong dal, vegetables, and roti, with minimal non-vegetarian intake. Experts highlight that such early dietary habits—rich in natural, unprocessed foods—help build strong immunity, better digestion, and long-term health, reducing risks of lifestyle diseases. The key takeaway is that consistent, simple food choices from a young age create a sustainable foundation for fitness and well-being.
